name: Damage numbers
author: LucienTo
description: Shows how much damage each hit does, from the wrench, a weapon or a bomb: a number pops up where the hit landed, flies off and fades out, in the flight style and colours you choose. Hits on the same enemy add up into one number while it shows, each hit renewing it.

settings.name: Style
settings.description: How the digits look. Pixel: a chunky pixel font. Original: wide square digits with rounded corners, shaded bright to dark, like a game menu. Comic: square blocky digits with their outline set off down and to the right.

settings.name: Opacity at start
settings.description: How solid a number is when it appears; it fades from there to nothing as it flies.

settings.name: Pop size
settings.description: How much bigger a number is for a moment when it appears, or when a hit adds to it.

settings.name: Flight style
settings.description: How a number flies off. Fan out: up and to either side. Straight up. Arc: thrown up and to the side, falling back down. Bounce: drops and bounces. Random: each number picks one of these.

settings.name: Duration
settings.description: How long a number flies and fades before it is gone, in seconds.

settings.name: Hit colour
settings.description: The colour of a number with one hit, as #RRGGBB.

settings.name: Many-hits colour
settings.description: The colour a number reaches as hits add up in it, as #RRGGBB. Each hit turns it a step further from the hit colour towards this one (yellow, orange, red with the defaults).

settings.name: Hits to full colour
settings.description: How many hits added up in a number turn it fully the many-hits colour.

settings.name: Kill colour on
settings.description: Show the hit that kills in the kill colour. Off: it keeps the colour its hits gave it (many enemies die in one hit, so with this on most numbers would be the kill colour).

settings.name: Kill colour
settings.description: The colour of the hit that kills, as #RRGGBB.

settings.name: Kill effect
settings.description: What the number does when its enemy dies. Spin and fall: it jumps a little, spins and drops to the ground. Break apart: its digits fly apart, each spinning and falling. None: it flies on as any number. It fades out as it goes.

settings.name: Enemies only
settings.description: Only enemies and people, not crates or other objects.

settings.name: Brightness boost
settings.description: Brighten the numbers, so dark places in the level do not dim them.

settings.name: Glow in the dark (experimental)
settings.description: Numbers light themselves, so they show in dark places. Only with OpenRAC's enhanced rendering on (Vulkan only): each level the mod checks, and without it uses the regular numbers. They glow in the colours set here (the hit colours in up to 6 steps), from the game's next start after a change.

settings.name: Critical colour (experimental)
settings.description: The colour of a critical hit, as #RRGGBB.

settings.name: Critical mark (experimental)
settings.description: An exclamation mark after a critical hit's number.

settings.name: Critical preview (experimental)
settings.description: The game has no critical hits yet. This share of hits, in percent, is shown as critical (bigger, shaking, in the critical colour) to try the look. 0 for none.

settings.name: Log hits
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for every hit the mod reads (what was hit, the kind and damage of the hit, who hit it, and whether a number showed or why not).
